title: Rajasthan Real Estate Appellate Tribunal Refuses to Condone a 694-Day Delay in Filing an Appeal
case_name: Modest Infra Ltd. v. Arvind Saini
card_summary: The Tribunal rejected a promoter's plea to condone a delay of roughly 694 days in filing its appeal against a RERA order. The promoter cited pending litigation, slow internal decisions and documentation problems, but gave no material to support any of it. The Tribunal held that RERA's emphasis on quick disposal, read with the proviso to Section 44(5), left no room to excuse unexplained inaction of this length.
card_tip: Calendar the limitation period for a RERA appeal the day the impugned order is received; vague internal process delays will not get a late appeal admitted, however strong the merits.
verification_notes: Reported only on IBC Laws (ibclaw.in), which carries this ruling on a dedicated case page, in its weekly RERA bulletin for 19-24 October 2026, and in its daily case-law update of 20 October 2026; no second independent outlet covering this specific Rajasthan REAT order was found, so this card should be read with that limitation in mind.
